compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from an app's "Favourites" section. It has two tabs at the top: "ADS" and "SEARCHES." The "ADS" tab is currently selected. The main content area indicates that there are no saved ads yet. It provides instructions on how to save a favourite ad by tapping the heart icon at the top of an ad. The screen also features a simple illustration of a laptop and a smartphone, both displaying a star icon, symbolizing favourites. The navigation bar at the top includes a menu icon and the title "Favourites." The status bar at the top shows various system icons and the time.
